reviewScope: The complete 25-tool local app-only candidate contract for five bundled UI resources. Current production discovery exposes 24 legacy app-endpoint tools; zero satisfy this complete contract, and the 25th local tool (billing_preview_billing_group_create) is not deployed. The hosted reference keeps the two create flows and their two previews fail-closed until a durable shared confirmation coordinator or upstream idempotency is deployed. Candidate tools must be hidden from model selection.

tools.name: number_intelligence_analyze
tools.title: Analyze phone number
tools.description: Billable Number Intelligence summary. Each call performs a Telnyx Number Lookup that can incur lookup charges and affect account balance, then adds safe owned-number, messaging, and voice enrichment by default. Selected enrichments can make additional Telnyx API requests. The tool does not create, change, or delete phone-number resources. Portability and cached reputation are opt-in; reputation is always fresh=false.

tools.name: number_intelligence_batch_analyze
tools.title: Batch analyze phone numbers
tools.description: Billable batch Number Intelligence for pasted CSV/newline input. Each unique accepted number performs a Telnyx Number Lookup that can incur lookup charges and affect account balance; selected enrichments can make additional Telnyx API requests. Runs sequentially, caps the batch at 25 and output near 1 MiB, omits raw payloads before stopping later lookups, reports partial output explicitly, redacts outputs, and does not create, change, or delete phone-number resources.

tools.name: billing_overview
tools.title: Open billing dashboard
tools.description: Open a single Telnyx billing dashboard with current balance, usage controls, billing groups, and guarded auto-recharge settings.

tools.name: billing_auto_recharge_setup
tools.title: Set up auto recharge
tools.description: Open a focused app for reviewing and preparing auto recharge. Opening this tool does not enable auto recharge or charge a payment method; a separately confirmed update changes future automatic charges.

tools.name: billing_stored_payment_top_up
tools.title: Top up with stored payment
tools.description: Open a focused app for reviewing a stored-payment top-up. Opening this tool does not charge a payment method; a separately previewed and confirmed transaction charges the saved method.

tools.name: billing_get_balance
tools.title: Get account balance
tools.description: Read account balance details from GET /balance.

tools.name: billing_get_auto_recharge_preferences
tools.title: Get auto-recharge preferences
tools.description: Read auto-recharge preferences from GET /payment/auto_recharge_prefs. This does not mutate billing settings.

tools.name: billing_list_billing_groups
tools.title: List billing groups
tools.description: List billing groups from GET /billing_groups. Billing group IDs are preserved for follow-up calls.

tools.name: billing_get_billing_group
tools.title: Get billing group
tools.description: Fetch one billing group by ID from GET /billing_groups/{id}.

tools.name: billing_usage_report_options
tools.title: Discover Usage Reports options (beta)
tools.description: Discover available products, dimensions, and metrics from GET /usage_reports/options. Usage Reports is beta.

tools.name: billing_query_usage
tools.title: Query Usage Reports (beta)
tools.description: Query the Telnyx Usage Reports beta endpoint and return structured JSON. Requires one product plus dimensions[] and metrics[]. Defaults format=json, managed_accounts=false, caps page size, and limits explicit start/end ranges to 31 days.

tools.name: billing_preview_auto_recharge_update
tools.title: Preview auto-recharge update
tools.description: Preview a financial side-effect update to PATCH /payment/auto_recharge_prefs. No mutation occurs; returns a diff and confirmation token.

tools.name: billing_update_auto_recharge_preferences
tools.title: Confirm auto-recharge update
tools.description: Guarded financial side-effect that changes future automatic charges: validates the confirmation token from billing_preview_auto_recharge_update, enforces conservative app caps, refetches current preferences, then PATCHes.

tools.name: billing_preview_stored_payment_transaction
tools.title: Preview stored payment top-up
tools.description: Preview a financial side-effect transaction to POST /payment/stored_payment_transactions. No mutation occurs; returns a short-lived, one-time confirmation token.

tools.name: billing_create_stored_payment_transaction
tools.title: Confirm stored payment top-up
tools.description: Guarded, billable financial side-effect: atomically reserves the one-time confirmation token from billing_preview_stored_payment_transaction, then charges the saved payment method with POST /payment/stored_payment_transactions. The reservation is released only after a successful bounded MCP result is produced.

tools.name: billing_preview_billing_group_update
tools.title: Preview billing group update
tools.description: Preview a billing group rename from PATCH /billing_groups/{id}. No mutation occurs; returns a diff and confirmation token.

tools.name: billing_update_billing_group
tools.title: Confirm billing group update
tools.description: Guarded destructive update that replaces an existing billing group name: validates the token from billing_preview_billing_group_update, refetches current group, then PATCHes /billing_groups/{id}.

tools.name: billing_preview_billing_group_create
tools.title: Preview billing group creation
tools.description: Preview adding a billing group with POST /billing_groups. No resource is created; returns a short-lived, one-time confirmation token bound to the credential and exact name.

tools.name: billing_create_billing_group
tools.title: Create billing group
tools.description: Guarded additive side effect: atomically reserves the one-time token from billing_preview_billing_group_create, then adds exactly one billing group with POST /billing_groups. This action does not charge a payment method or alter auto-recharge settings.

tools.name: voice_monitor_dashboard
tools.title: Open Voice Monitor
tools.description: Open a single read-only Telnyx voice monitor workspace with preloaded dropdowns, active calls, call timelines, status lookup, and recording search.

tools.name: voice_monitor_list_options
tools.title: Load Voice Monitor options
tools.description: Discover app-friendly dropdown options for connections, call-control applications, and voice numbers so users do not need to paste IDs.

tools.name: voice_monitor_active_calls
tools.title: List active calls
tools.description: List active calls for a selected Call Control Application ID. If omitted, discovers a bounded set of call-control applications and queries each; it never assumes a global active-calls endpoint. Aggregate output is capped near 1 MiB, reports truncation explicitly, and stops querying later connections once the cap is reached.

tools.name: voice_monitor_call_timeline
tools.title: Read call timeline
tools.description: Read Telnyx GET /call_events with supported filters. Prefer call_leg_id or call_session_id/application_session_id; connection-only searches default to the last 24 hours.

tools.name: voice_monitor_call_status
tools.title: Get call status
tools.description: Read call status from GET /calls/{call_control_id}. This is read-only and does not issue Call Control commands.

tools.name: voice_monitor_recordings
tools.title: Search recordings
tools.description: Search Telnyx recordings for post-call investigation. Recording URLs, transcripts, and metadata are redacted in output.
